STRICT RULES & ARCHITECTURE ### 1.1 CSS-First Architecture & Zero Inline CSS - **No Inline CSS:** The `style="..."` attribute is forbidden anywhere in the HTML. Zero exceptions. - **Class/ID Selectors Only:** All colors, layout, gradients, states, and animations must be targeted exclusively via class or ID selectors in `style.css`. - **Minimal HTML Modifications:** HTML must remain semantic and styling-agnostic — changing the entire visual theme must require edits to `style.css` only, never markup changes. ### 1.2 CSS Variables (`var(--...)`) & Theme Tokens All visual tokens must live in `:root` (light mode) and be re-mapped under the dark mode scope (§1.3): - **Colors (Light Mode defaults):** - `--primary: #d4b46a` (brass — CTAs, accents, focus rings) - `--secondary: #8a7454` (bronze — secondary accents, borders) - `--bg-primary`: a lightened cream wash derived from `#d8c9a8` (e.g., toward `#efe6d2`). Never `#ffffff`. - `--bg-secondary: #fefefe` (elevated card/surface color — `#fefefe` is the only near-white permitted) - `--text-primary: #241610` (espresso) · `--text-secondary:` a bronze derived from `#8a7454`, darkened as needed (e.g., toward `#75603f`) to pass WCAG AA on cream surfaces - `--text-success`: a muted patina/verdigris green harmonized with the brass palette · `--text-error`: a wine-crimson derived from `#2e1a22` (e.g., `#b34258` family) — both AA-compliant in both modes - `--border-default: rgba(36, 22, 16, 0.18)` · `--border-success` and `--border-error` matching their text tokens - **Contrast Pairing (mandatory, both themes):** Every light background token pairs with a dark text token; every dark background token pairs with a light text token. `#d4b46a` buttons must use espresso (`#241610`) text. - **Gradient Tokens:** Define `--gradient-brass: linear-gradient(135deg, #d4b46a, #8a7454)`, `--gradient-hero` (layered radial brass-glow + umber vignette), and `--gradient-text` (headline clip gradient) as variables so both themes can remap them. - **Shape & Depth:** `--radius-sm: 6px`, `--radius-md: 14px`, `--radius-lg: 24px`; `--shadow-sm`, `--shadow-md` (warm umber-tinted, e.g., `rgba(18,10,6,...)` — never flat pure black). - **Spacing & Motion:** `--spacing-gap: 1.5rem` (scale section rhythm with `clamp()`); `--transition-fast: 150ms`, `--transition-normal: 300ms`, `--ease-standard: cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1)`; you may add `--ease-spring: cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.56, 0.64, 1)` for tactile "tick" feedback only. - **Elevation:** `--z-dropdown: 100`, `--z-modal: 400`, `--z-toast: 500`. No component may use raw z-index values. ### 1.3 Mandatory Dark Mode Support - **Implementation:** Re-map every token under both a `.dark` class on `` (JS-toggled) and `@media (prefers-color-scheme: dark)` as the no-JS/no-preference fallback. Suggested dark palette: `--bg-primary: #120a06`, `--bg-secondary: #241610`, `--text-primary: #d8c9a8`, `--text-secondary:` lightened bronze (e.g., `#c4ab85` family) for AA, `--primary: #d4b46a`, `--border-default: rgba(216, 201, 168, 0.18)`. - **Exception Clause:** The source style designates Light as the flagship mode — default the showcase to Light styling, but Dark Mode is still mandatory and must ship fully designed with the same warm umber/brass mood (no neutral grays), never an afterthought. - **Theme Switching:** Switching must only re-map variables — no HTML restructuring. - **Persistence:** Persist the user's choice in `localStorage`; on first visit fall back to `prefers-color-scheme`. A visible toggle control (sun/moon Material icons, swapped via CSS) must carry correct `aria-pressed` and `aria-label` ("Toggle dark mode"). ### 1.4 Flexbox Layout & Mobile-First Alignment - **Default Alignment Rule:** Every flex container must default to `align-items: center` (`items-center` in Tailwind) unless an exception is explicitly justified in a CSS comment — e.g., text blocks inside cards may use `flex-start` for readability; state the reason inline. - **Mobile-Friendly First:** Author all layouts mobile-first: flex rows must convert to `flex-direction: column` on small viewports; use `clamp()` for type, spacing, and dial sizing. Horizontal scrolling is forbidden at every viewport width down to 320px. ### 1.5 Framework Default & Tailwind CSS Integration - Use Tailwind CSS (Play CDN acceptable) or clean custom CSS organized with Tailwind's `@layer` / `@apply` directives. All utility usage must map back to the CSS variables above and to generic reusable classes (`.btn`, `.card`, `.input-group`) — no one-off magic values scattered through markup. ### 1.6 Typography & Icons (Google Fonts Mandatory) - **Text:** Load from Google Fonts via `` (with `preconnect`) and bind to tokens: `--font-display: 'Fraunces', serif` (headings — alternative: Cormorant Garamond), `--font-base: 'Inter', sans-serif` (body), `--font-mono: 'Space Mono', monospace` (numerals, prices, step counters, eyebrows — the "engraved dial label" voice). - **Icons:** Google Material Symbols (Rounded) only.
